page.layout: One page of text in a single column, with two notes in the left margin: "Edictum Cæsaris diplomati conforme." beside the start of the second paragraph, and "Groninga-ni offerentes se fortunam negligunt." beside "quatriduo".

main_text.p: »LEGENTVR, IN EQVESTRI ORDINE OMNES CENSEANTVR: pecunia quoq; aurea argenteaq; feriunda ius & potestatem senatui eidem facere : Pro his pos ere vicissim, ex assignata hac provincia ut x millia aureorum Rhenenf. tributum quotannis sibi pendant : In hunc finem Joannem Steinbergium & Arnoldum Loum jureconsultos legatos in Frisiam jam mittere, qui cingulo equestri consules & senatores pro more induant, ac reliquis eius ordinis insignibus ornent, ornatosq; statim in possessionem potestatis istius in regionibus Trans-lavicana Frisia immittant, omnesq; earum regionum ordines jubeant, senatui huic velut imperatoris legato perpetuo, iusta ac legitima edicenti, statutaq; promulganti parere, non secus ac si ipse ea ediceret & promulgaret imperator. Poenaq; contumacib. & huic decreto obsistetib.denunciata.

Signatum diploma anno M. cccc. lxxx, die xii Calendarum Decemb. In edicto ad ordines in his regionibus, praeter oppida Doccumu, Leoardiam, Franekeram, Bolsuerdiam, Snecam, Worcumum, longus virorum praecipua nobilitatis catalogus nominatim est expressus, mandatumque omnibus, uti senatui Groniugano munus illud pro imperatore gerenti parerent, eiusq; edictis & statutis obsequerentur, gravib. propositis poenis secus facientibus. Id scriptum Edictum Cæsaris diplomati conforme.quatriduo post, ad diem vii Calend. Decemb. Groninga-ni offerentes se fortunam negligunt.Et haec quidem monstrata senatui a legatis legendi copia facta. Sed quod pecuniam in loco

page.notes: Two marginal notes on the left, the first one partly beside "In edicto", the second beside "quatriduo". The paragraph of the decree is set in italic; the start of the next paragraph is in italic only in part. Line-start "»" marks on the quoted decree are printed at every line; they are given once here. The word "obsistetib." is printed as shown, the long s is printed as s throughout and is read as s. The catchword "negli-" is set at the right under the last line.
